p="ext/ox/err.c"
s=open(p).read()
insert="#ifdef __SANITIZE_ADDRESS__\nconst char *__asan_default_options(void) { return \"verify_asan_link_order=0:detect_leaks=0\"; }\n#endif\n\n"
